annotations.title: Does a stablecoin hold its dollar

description: Does each USD stablecoin hold its dollar? Per stablecoin: its price, the gap to $1 now (fraction and basis points), holds or off_peg against a ±2% band, and the widest move above and below $1 over 90 days. FREE. DefiLlama’s aggregate price, read every six hours: not a redemption quote. For tokenized shares against their stock, use stock_peg.

q.description: One stablecoin by symbol (USDC), name or CoinGecko id. Leave out for the largest by market cap.

name: stablecoin_peg

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

items.description: One row per stablecoin: priceUsd, gapToDollar (fraction), gapBps, state (holds, off_peg, not_read), worst90d. SINCE 2026-11-28 (plugin audit P1-9): nativeUnits (tokens in circulation), nominalPegValueUsd (units × $1), priceAdjustedValueUsd (units × price), chainMatrix {networks, rows [{chain, units, share}] (all with q, the five largest without), sumUnits, source}, reconciliation {state agree | gap_partly_measured | gap_unattributed | one_source, sources [{source, circulatingUnits, totalUnits, marketCapUsd, priceUsd, asOf}], gapUnits, gapShare, components [{key, units, source, says}] (parts we measured, as candidates, never the cause), measuredIfAllApplyUnits, unattributedUnits, timeApartMinutes, says}. marketCapUsd is DEPRECATED: it is units × $1, not price × supply.
